sources.title: Clef — Cloudflare's open decision models answer… | AI/TLDR
sources.snippet: Clef is listed on Workers AI as @cf/cloudflare/clef at $0.24 per million input tokens, according to Cloudflare's model page. The weights for Clef and Clef-flash are also free to download from Hugging Face under the Apache-2.0 license, so teams can run the models on their own GPUs instead of paying for hosted inference.
